a: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
p: Rabbana-ghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa li-l-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmu-l-ḥisāb.
m: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
